# SecureLayer

> Free security intelligence for developers who install open-source software.

SecureLayer audits popular open-source GitHub repositories across 9 security checks before you install them. Scores are pre-computed weekly — no live API calls, no rate limits.

## Tools

- [GitHub Security Assessments](https://securelayer.co/github-security-assessment): Pre-audited repos scored across 9 checks (SECURITY.md quality, Dependabot, branch protection, credential hygiene, CI/CD, active maintenance, license, code of conduct, contributing guidelines). Grades A+ to F. Penalties for known incidents (−10 pts) and open critical/high CVEs (−5 pts).
- [AI Prompts to improve Cybersecurity](https://securelayer.co/cybersecurity-ai-prompts): free, tested prompt templates for security tasks.

## Scoring methodology

9 binary checks weighted 1–15 pts each (total 100). OpenSSF Scorecard score adds up to 10 bonus pts. Known security incidents deduct 10 pts. Open CRITICAL or HIGH CVEs (OSV.dev) deduct 5 pts. Grade bands: A ≥85 · B ≥70 · C ≥55 · D ≥40 · F <40.
